mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_PermissionMatrix leaves PermMatrix.Allowed unconstrained; the injection forces a forbidden cell (ComplianceReviewer → ClaimApplication) into the Allowed set, which LeastPrivilege and FR_004_ComplianceReviewerReadOnly must detect.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermissionMatrixViolation { ComplianceReviewer -> ClaimApplication in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the constraint that the deciding officer must be the assigned officer. The injection forces a Decision whose decidedBy differs from the application's assignedOfficer, directly violating FR_013_AssignedOfficerDecides.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NonAssignedOfficerDecides { some d: Decision | some u: User | u.role = LoanOfficer and u != d.application.assignedOfficer and d.decidedBy = u }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the in-flight uniqueness constraint. The injection forces a single customer to own two Submitted applications simultaneously, violating FR-008.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_TwoInFlightSameCustomer { some disj a1, a2: LoanApplication | a1.customer = a2.customer and a1.status = Submitted and a2.status = Submitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the requirement that every application has exactly one submission audit entry. The injection forces an application to have no initial audit entry, violating AuditCompleteness and FR_009_SubmissionAuditEntry.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingInitialAuditEntry { some a: LoanApplication | no e: ApplicationEvent | e.application = a and no e.previousStatus }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the coupling between decision records and application status. The injection forces an Approved application to have no associated Decision, violating the atomicity invariant in FR_015_AtomicDecision.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DecidedWithoutDecisionRecord { some a: LoanApplication | a.status = Approved and no d: Decision | d.application = a }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the restriction on which (previous, new) status pairs are valid in audit events. The injection forces an audit entry with previousStatus=Approved (a terminal state), violating FR_016_DecidedImmutability's assertion that no event departs from a decided status.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_TransitionFromApproved { some e: ApplicationEvent | e.previousStatus = Approved and e.newStatus = Rejected }
